2026-10-16-manitoba-saskatchewan.summary: Saskatchewan’s October 15 preview identifies this as a rematch of Manitoba’s 40–22 opening win and reports that a Huskies win would secure a playoff berth. Both teams return from the conference bye. That earlier result gives Manitoba evidence it can win the matchup, while Saskatchewan’s subsequent winning run makes the opener an incomplete guide to current form.

2026-10-16-calgary-ubc.summary: UBC’s October 14 preview notes Calgary’s 23–7 win in the first meeting and describes the return game as consequential for playoff positioning. Its reporting highlights UBC’s rushing attack and Calgary receiver Matt Sibley. Those contrasting routes to moving the ball make early-down defensive efficiency a useful matchup to follow.
